meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein **dark spots aur dull skin** ke liye sabse practical choice aam taur par **10% vitamin C serum** hota hai, especially agar aap beginner ho ya skin sensitive hai. Dermatologist-style guidance ke mutabik, **stable 10% vitamin C** morning routine mein sunscreen ke saath use karna best starting point hai; **Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C Face Serum** ko brightness aur pigmentation ke liye suitable bataya gaya hai, aur **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum** bhi widely used option hai.[3][13][16]

Aapke use-case ke hisaab se short recommendation:

- **Best overall for most people:** **Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C Face Serum** — dull skin aur pigmentation ke liye balanced option, aur niacinamide ke saath bhi compatible बताया गया है.[3][13]
- **Best if you want a stronger option for stubborn dark spots:** **Pilgrim 15% Vitamin C Face Serum** ya **Foxtale 15% L-Ascorbic Acid Vitamin C Serum**.[3][14]
- **Best budget-friendly popular option:** **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum**.[16]
- **If you prefer a mainstream mass-market option:** **Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum** dark spots aur dullness ke liye marketed hai.[12]

**Meri simple pick:**  
- Agar aap **new ho** to **10% serum** lo.  
- Agar aapki skin **already vitamin C tolerate karti hai** aur dark spots zyada stubborn hain, to **15%** try kar sakte ho.[3]

**Use kaise karein:**
- **Subah** lagao.
- Uske baad **sunscreen** zaroor lagao, warna dark spots par expected result weak ho sakta hai.[3][8]
- Results usually **weeks** mein aate hain; mild dullness jaldi improve ho sakti hai, while deeper pigmentation ko zyada time lag sakta hai.[11][8]

**Agar aap sensitive skin wale ho:**  
- **10%** se start karo, high-strength formula se irritation ka risk zyada ho sakta hai.[3]

Agar chaho, main **₹500–₹1500 ke andar India ke 5 best vitamin C serums** ka exact shortlist bhi de sakta hoon.
